capacity.description: (Optional) The size of the Redis cache (0-6 depending on family).
capacity.title: Capacity

family.description: (Optional) The SKU family: C (Basic/Standard) or P (Premium).
family.title: Family

identity_ids.description: (Optional) A list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs. Used when identity_type includes UserAssigned.
identity_ids.title: Identity ids

identity_type.description: (Optional) The type of Managed Identity: SystemAssigned, UserAssigned or 'SystemAssigned, UserAssigned'. Leave null for no identity.
identity_type.title: Identity type

maxmemory_policy.description: (Optional) The eviction policy when the memory limit is reached.
maxmemory_policy.title: Maxmemory policy

name.description: (Required) The name of the Redis Cache (globally unique). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
name.title: Name

public_network_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether public network access is allowed for this cache.
public_network_access_enabled.title: Public network access enabled

redis_version.description: (Optional) Redis version. Only major version is needed (4 or 6).
redis_version.title: Redis version

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group in which to create the resource. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
resource_group_name.title: Resource group name

shard_count.description: (Optional) Number of shards for a Premium cluster.
shard_count.title: Shard count

sku_name.description: (Optional) The SKU of Redis: Basic, Standard or Premium.
sku_name.title: Sku name

subnet_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the subnet to deploy the cache in. Only for Premium SKU.
subnet_id.title: Subnet id

tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.
tags.title: Tags

zones.description: (Optional) Availability zones to deploy the cache in. Premium only.
zones.title: Zones
